correctness.rationale: Exact all-face and eleven-link enumeration certifies a pure normal 3-pseudomanifold with connected nonorientable 10-vertex links of Euler characteristic zero. Exact GF3 boundary ranks 10/45/55 and tight rational upper bounds give Betti vector (1,0,10,0). Stabilized transitive tournament simplices are fixed pointwise; Lefschetz gives G-character 10,-1,0 and Maschke identifies the augmentation module. Character averaging determines quotients. Reproduced standalone checker succeeds.

McCarthy-Springfield counts transitive subtournaments, not link incidence types. Neither result implies the claimed extra data.

value.rationale: The unique natural eleven-point doubly regular Paley tournament is a published finite torsion example whose local singularities and full affine action were not determined by its known Moore-wedge homotopy type. Eleven explicitly identified Klein-bottle links and the full ten-dimensional affine character reveal qualitative structural information, distinguishing acyclic translation/full quotients from dilation quotient H2 dimension two. Not a restated face count or routine arbitrary slice.
